trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are marked unhealthy in the deployment history. v2.3.0 is the most recent release marked healthy, so no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Result:** Health is back to normal. Error rate dropped from 0.18 to 0.002 and the service reports healthy.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the incident was opened once. Its summary describes the rollback and says v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed.

Next steps are to watch checkout-api for a while to confirm the recovery holds and to investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing.
